name: ai-chat
title: AI Chat
description: A complete chat app for Next.js: a new chat screen, conversations that stream replies, projects, search, rename and delete, a tools and model menu, share, copy, regenerate and edit.
docs:
Installs a full app under app/ai-chat. Run your dev server and open /ai-chat. Replace replyFor and the stream in lib/ai-chat/store.tsx with your model API.

It uses these theme tokens: background, card, muted, accent, border, primary and chart-2, chart-3.
